tx:
The rewards below were given depending on how much the challenge earned in items gathered or cost. So the challenge bag would give back the amount of gold in items/coins using current Grand Exchange prices; however, this could fluctuate in wealth.
For example: on a challenge in which required players to make summer pies, the bag would reimburse they for roughly how much the strawberry, watermelon, cooking apple, and pie shell cost. If they opted to buy raw summer pies instead (much more expensive): they would not be reimbursed the higher amount. So, for the most balanced outcome, it was best to choose the cheaper option to complete the challenge. Ironman Mode players would only be reimbursed for half the normal value.
